About Mike Learn more about your Congressman. Contact Me I value all feedback from constituents. Our office is here to serve you. Newsletter Sign-Up Subscribe to receive email news and updates about our work in Congress. About Mike Mike Rogers is a sixth generation East Alabamian. He is a conservative, a Christian, the father of three and married to his wife, Beth, for over 35 years. Mike grew up in Calhoun County, Alabama, in the small mill village of Blue Mountain. His mother worked in the local textile mill and his father was a firefighter. Mike learned the values of family, hard work and sacrifice from his parents.
